works.body:
If you don't mind, I would like to ask you to illustrate two people, a man and a woman!

Male】・Height: 170cm-ish, boy to young man.
Height: 170cm-ish, boy to young man, white eyes, normal build, rebellious personality.
Girl
 Large girl, over 200cm tall ・Breasts are large ・With so-called "mine" type fashion and make-up

I would like to see a relationship where the big girl is in love with the boy and the boy is rebellious but blushes at the girl's pressure. Hair color, clothes, poses, etc. are up to you.
 I would appreciate your consideration. Thank you in advance.

Thank you for your appeal!
We are very honored that you took the time to look over our creation!

We would love to have you draw Kaito and Seito.
I have already set up their appearance to some extent, but you are free to arrange their clothes in a way that makes it easier to draw.

Kaido.
He has dark blue hair and blue eyes. His expression is hard and the light in his eyes is subdued.
The feather-like parts on her head are part of her hair.
His physique looks average, but he works out hard.
He has a strong sense of responsibility and is very disciplined.

Seito.
He has peach-colored hair with a light blue gradation at the ends and pale blue eyes.
He has not eaten well, so he is slender and has a body shape that is difficult to distinguish between men and women.
He has a modest personality, but he is willing to work for harmony and leadership.

His team is a logistics support team, mainly supplying supplies and support.
Hideto, Shakuto, and Hideto are cheerful and friendly,
Mametou is timid and runs away,
Ling Dou is moody, but he wants to get the job done quickly, so he will concentrate on it.
I would like to ask for your help if you have extra power within the range of the amount.

I am attaching the documents for your review.
I look forward to working with you.
